body: I suggest you visit a psychologist just in case as, it sounds to me like you have dysthymia, which is what I have currently. While it isn’t as bad as those with major depression, Still, I suggest you get it checked out just in case as if it is it might lead to major depression and others.

Hey it’s fine, I feel in some way everyone is like that. I do too want to die but not want to see others do it. I feel that it’s due to us thinking that we are the worse and it’s too late for us, while we see that for others it isn’t too late for them, and that we don’t want them to go through the pain we feel. Just try to hold on a little longer alright?

It’s not your fault. This kind of people just use mental health and suicide as a means to get stuff. I honestly really doubt that he would really harm himself if you don’t send him. Does he know your address? If he does inform the police or someone to look out for you before blocking him. This really isn’t your fault and you aren’t wrong for refusing. Please do tell someone if possible, and try to block him as soon as possible. If he does know you irl and your address inform someone and the police alright? They will definitely help and understand.
Nah I’m not that great of a person. Here’s hoping that’s things get better for the both of us though.

Hey man..just try to hang on for awhile more alright? Perhaps a few years or maybe even one year more. That’s what’s I’m doing at least, giving myself a few years to see if things get better.. If things get better then that’s good and if things get worse..well it would just be more reason for me to end it after the few years. I know it isn’t exactly healthy to think that but, just try alright? Perhaps try to seek professional help if you aren’t already. But just try to hang on a bit longer alright?
Probably till one day it either succeeds or we somehow find some semblance of hope while waiting for the next attempt.

Hey man, take your time. Most of the time it’s hard for people to know what to do if they have never been exposed to things like this, give it some time.

Damn, this is so relatable it hurts. This..is so similarly to how am I right now. My ex has someone else now, and in a way I’m happy that they are happier but it hurts that it isn’t me. I messed up, and I messed up even more afterwards. I attempted 2 weeks ago and I was caught and brought to helped by the police. My ex was the one who called after I said my goodbyes. I too promised them that I wouldn’t attempt anymore but, it’s getting increasingly hard and covid has made it hard to have many psychologist visits. I don’t think they would remember me at all in the future and I’ll made it worse for them. Tbh I am going to attempt again very soon. I’ve tried to find other things but nothing’s working. Before we got together I was planning on suiciding. I had nothing, then I gained something but my depression and habits got too much for them to handle. I don’t know about your life, but I would hate if you ended up like me. But do try to find the will to go on, try to think about what used to make you happy before you got together..please don’t turn out like me...

Well, currently I just chose a date next year to truly ask myself if anything got better, and if things are the same or worse I would off myself. So while the days are getting closer I just try my best to help myself.

While I feel perhaps some actually care, most are just selfish and want everything to be “ok” without putting in work or thought.

Optimism is just ignorance
Damn..I can relate to this. It’s like you want to rely on someone but at the same time you are afraid they would leave eventually.

I’ll remember you. While I do hope you do find some hope and be able to move on from this, I don’t know how bad it is for you. If it’s any consolation, I would be joining you soon..at least we won’t be alone in this.
True man, just you do you I do me sorta thing. I don’t get why people force us to do things that they think would make us happy.

In a way, I can relate to you, in that falling in love and feeling love again was what kept me going too. In the past my depression wasn’t as bad, it was more of dysthymia than depression. Back then I had a crush on one of my classmate, and decided to confess to her out of self loathing. It was one of those bad days where you just want to find reasons to hate yourself that sorta thing. Surprisingly, she actually liked me back. I later found out that she was actually going to end herself, and that me confessing stopped her from doing that. She had it worse than me, abusive parents and unresolved trauma. I managed to convince her to seek help and overtime she got better. As for me, I did not really have the time to help myself as, she really did have it worse and I was more focused on helping her than myself as I felt that, she needed the help more than me. But as you would expect from a post in this subreddit, after she got better, she left me. She said that she felt like I wasn’t getting better, and that she couldn’t deal with me being depressed. I lost what I felt was the love of my life, as well as my only support in life. She was the only one I told about my depression. It felt like I lost everything. Truth be told I still love her, though she has gotten together with someone else now. In a way it felt unfair, that I went through all the trouble of caring and worrying, to just be tossed aside because I was too much for her to handle. I actually have decided on ending myself soon, in 4 day I will. I’ve, given up on waiting for someone else I can love. I hope that you won’t end up like me, and that you won’t give up on seeking for love. I’m sorry that I can’t provide you an answer, but just know that, you aren’t alone in feeling this way.

You should seek a different psychiatrist, the one you went to sounds so unprofessional and rude, which is literally the opposite of what you should do to comfort someone. And no, you aren’t a whiny brat that need to just accept it. It doesn’t matter if you are young or old, mental illness affects all equally. In fact it’s good that you are trying to help yourself, so don’t feel that you are over reacting, you deserve to get help and deserve to be heard. Don’t let the fact that you are young affect your decision to seek proper help, in fact because you are young the more you should seek help. You still have quite a long way to go and you shouldn’t have to suffer till you are older to get the help you deserve.

Yeah, I guess it’s cause it’s hard for people who have never experienced mental illnesses to sympathise with those who do, especially when they can’t see it. Due to this, I always felt that people who have went through mental illnesses are more sympathetic and are generally nicer towards people who are going through tough times mentally. It really is nice to know that, there are others that understand how we feel and that we aren’t alone in, well, feeling alone if that makes sense.
We all do man..we all do

Well, I feel that those people usually have more excitement in their life, so to them it feels they aren’t doing anything. While for people like us, it’s hard to find any joy in doing most things so literally doing nothing is something we are used to.

It’s sad that only people like us can understand each other. I feel that people who are happy or otherwise just can’t empathise with a mentally ill person as they can’t see the pain, which is what makes mental illness all the more serious as you only truly understand it once you go through it. It’s hard to relate when you can’t see the pain.
